title: 第236章 这是唯一能帮你做的事了第235章 林恩是个十足的恶人
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
狠话当然谁都会撂的啊。
不过林恩并不在意，因为他可并不想在世界上掀起祸乱，对于毁灭世界和建立恐怖统治什么的啊，他也并没有什么特别浓厚的兴趣，他最大的愿望就是多养几个小红，拉几条产线，调戏一下女武神，过个吃穿不愁的富家翁的生活。
（～￣▽￣）～
而想要过这样的生活，那当然是要把所有不安定的因数全都解决掉才可以啊。
“快！不要给我耍什么花样！”
林恩闭着眼，督促着她传输。
“既然都灵魂交融了，那就把你知道的事情给我拷贝一份传过来，记住，不要在里面给我动什么手脚，不然如果真的被我发现的话，我立马切断你和浩日的联系，让永夜在七日之后降临，你不要觉得我做不到。”
完了，这句话他都感觉自己已经说顺嘴了，果然拿捏着别人把柄的感觉真的是非常的好，张嘴就可以来啊。
对不起了，女武神陛下，这就是烧烤我十年的代价啊。
神泉纱夜眼眶通红，握着从他那里交换过来的奥菲希尔的源质，一声不吭，只能被迫地给他传输关于她七位神侍的资料。
而这又是何其地悲哀。
因为某种意义上来说，这就是一种背叛。
她在用不断地背叛和助纣为虐，从这个恶魔的手里换取那世界延续的保证，可是她非常清楚，这也只不过是一种慢性死亡，因为终有一天，当这个家伙在下面彻底立足之后，那她也一定会被他所杀，而整个世界就都会沦为他享乐的巢穴。
“对不起，大家……对不起。”
她用力地低下了头，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒落下。
“我没办法……我……我……”
那一刻。
坚持了整整一千年的她终于是忍不住哭了出来，整张脸都埋在了手臂当中。
在被这个家伙监禁了之后都没有哭，但是在被迫地给予了她下界七位眷属的情报之后，这个坚强的女武神却是哭了，伤心不已。
林恩（；￣д￣）了。

“喂，只是交换情报而已，我又没让她们给我生孩子，你哭什么哭啊。”
“你一定会的！”
神泉纱夜歇斯底里地叫道。
“你这个魔鬼！你这个卑鄙扭曲的混蛋！你什么事情做不出来，你下地狱吧！”
林恩（*￣︶￣）道：
“这儿不就是地狱吗？”
“……”
不过林恩也没有继续欺负她，毕竟来日方长，真坏了就不好了，现在当务之急还是得赶紧让奥菲希尔活过来，要是不好好工作而鱼死网破的话，那可就得不偿失了。
在从她那里得到了关于她七位神侍所有的资料之后，林恩这才满意地在她面前坐了下来，将那些资料变成了一本书，当着她的面翻阅了起来。
“所以奥菲希尔真的能活过来吗？你可不要诓我，她可是我们两个人共同的仆从啊。”
“你闭嘴！！”
神泉纱夜对他怒目而视。
她现在一点都不想理会这个恶魔。
去死！
去死！
死！！
她迅速地抹去眼泪，目光望向了面前的源质，身上的圣焰瞬间熊熊燃起，长长的金发宛若烟雾一样飘荡而起，一缕缕来自灵魂的精粹化作了细密的光线，围绕着那枚源质不断地旋转。
她闭上了眼睛，她的身体也随着那枚源质悬浮而起。
而林恩很快便惊异地看到，那枚源质当中涌动着那一缕缕灵魂的碎片竟是在那神魂力量的滋补之下，竟是一点点地有了重新拼接的迹象。
“这么屌？”

因为这无异于生人魂，肉白骨。
果然不愧是女武神啊，确实是有两下子的啊。
“但这样拼接回来的话，那个新长出来的她还是她吗？”
林恩忍不住犹疑地问道。
“就像把叶子剪了，新长出来的叶子怎么也很难说是原来的叶子吧？”
content_en:
Of course anyone will be put off by harsh words.
But Lin En didn't care, because he didn't want to cause chaos in the world, and he didn't have any particular interest in destroying the world or establishing a reign of terror. His biggest wish was to raise a few more little girls, run a few production lines, tease the Valkyries, and live a life of a wealthy man with no worries about food and clothing.
(～￣▽￣)～
If you want to live such a life, of course you must resolve all the unstable factors.
"Quick! Don't play any tricks on me!"
Lin closed her eyes and urged her to transmit.
"Since our souls are all fused, then send me a copy of what you know. Remember, don't do anything to me in it. Otherwise, if I really find out, I will immediately cut off the connection between you and Haori and let Yongye come in seven days. Don't think I can't do it."
When it was over, he felt like he had already spoken the words smoothly. As expected, it felt really good to have someone else's control. You could do it just by opening your mouth.
I'm sorry, Your Majesty Valkyrie, this is the price for roasting me for ten years.
Shenquan Saya's eyes were red, and she was holding the source of Ofishiel exchanged from him. She said nothing and could only be forced to transmit to him the information about her seven divine attendants.
And this is so sad.
Because in a sense, this is a betrayal.
She is using constant betrayal and aiding the evildoers to exchange the guarantee of the continuation of the world from this devil, but she knows very well that this is just a kind of slow death, because one day, when this guy completely establishes himself below, she will definitely be killed by him, and the whole world will become his lair for pleasure.
"I'm sorry, everyone...I'm sorry."
She lowered her head hard, tears falling down.
"I can't help it...I...I..."
That moment.
After persisting for a thousand years, she finally couldn't help crying and buried her face in her arms.
She didn't even cry after being imprisoned by this guy, but after being forced to give her the information about the seven descendants of the lower realm, this strong Valkyrie cried and was extremely sad.
Lynn (;￣д￣).
"Hey, it's just an exchange of information. I didn't let them give me a baby. Why are you crying?"
"You will definitely do it!"
Kamizumi Saya shouted hysterically.
"You devil! You despicable and twisted bastard! If you can't do anything, go to hell!"
Lin En (*￣︶￣) said:
"Isn't this hell?"
"..."
However, Lin En did not continue to bully her. After all, there was only so much time to come, and it would not be good if it really went bad. The top priority now was to revive Aoifei Shier quickly. If she didn't work hard and the situation was ruined, it would be more of a loss than the gain.
After getting all the information about her seven divine attendants from her, Lin En sat down in front of her with satisfaction, turned the information into a book, and started reading it in front of her.
"So can Ophihir really survive? Don't lie to me, she is our common servant."
"Shut up!!"
Kamizumi Saya glared at him.
She didn't want to pay attention to this demon at all now.
Go to hell!
Go to hell!
die! !
She quickly wiped away her tears and looked at the source material in front of her. The holy flames on her body instantly ignited, and her long blond hair floated like smoke. Wisps of essence from the soul turned into fine rays of light, constantly rotating around the source material.
She closed her eyes, and her body floated with the source of matter.
And Lin En was soon surprised to see that the fragments of souls surging in the source material were actually being reassembled bit by bit under the nourishment of the power of the soul.Signs of pick up.
"Such a dick?"
Because this is tantamount to giving birth to a human soul, flesh and white bones.
She is truly worthy of being a Valkyrie, she does have a lot of tricks up her sleeve.
"But if it's spliced back together like this, will the new one still be her?"
Linn couldn't help but asked hesitantly.
"It's like cutting off a leaf. It's hard to say that the newly grown leaves are the original leaves, right?"
